brief: Split-field imperative — "Hire the busy one." reversed out of an industry-gold marquee, the day's work stacked as a warm-black ledger opposite, the divide as the argument.
rationale: The phrase is an order. Because the aphorism is two-part, the composition argues with itself across a divide.
legacyArchetype: A busy man's ledger, split against a gold marquee.

colorScheme.color_story: A saturated 46° gold floods the left field while the idle other kind recedes into warm near-black on the right.

shell.nav: marginal — three lowercase links stacked in the top-right margin of the dark ledger panel, no band, no pills, no border
shell.footer: ledger foot — build stamp + season + music folded into the base of the right ledger column
